patch_list: Suppresses DAP (Data Analytics Pipeline), Statsig experimentation client, Sentry crash reporting, and usage tracking in DeepL to reduce data sent to DeepL servers.
Hooks Google Play Billing to bypass in-app purchase verification for DeepL Pro. Unlocks tone and formality selection, extended translation limits, and advanced dictionary features.
Unlock Unlimited Document and PDF Translations - DeepL (Experimental)
Removes the monthly document translation limit (PDF, DOCX, PPTX), unlocks higher file size thresholds, and enables full document layout preservation in DeepL.
Unlock Unlimited Glossaries and Writing Styles - DeepL (Experimental)
Unlocks unlimited custom glossary terminology pairs and enables advanced professional writing styles (Academic, Technical, Casual, Business) in DeepL.
Unlock Voice Conversations and Transcript Pro - DeepL (Experimental)
Unlocks DeepL Voice (real-time speech translation), multi-party Conversation mode, group voice sessions, and Voice Pro transcript features normally gated behind a paid plan.
